title: Sentinel AI SSE Event Contract
description: Normative contract for events emitted on the per-audit SSE stream (GET /api/v1/audits/{auditId}/stream). Every event shares a common envelope and is one of the 4 core types: AGENT_THOUGHT, TOOL_EXECUTION, VULNERABILITY_FOUND, AUDIT_COMPLETED. Delivery is in-order per audit (NFR-A2) and each event id doubles as the SSE `id:` field for Last-Event-ID resync (plan decision D-6). LLM provider degradation is surfaced as a TOOL_EXECUTION event with status failed/degraded, never as a transport error (NFR-A3).

severity.description: Matches the Severity enum in specs/openapi.yaml.

commonEnvelope.description: Envelope shared by every SSE event. Consumers validate the envelope and switch on `type` to discriminate the payload.

id.description: Monotonic sequence number per audit, starting at 1. Also used as the SSE `id:` field.

timestamp.description: Emission time (RFC 3339). Rendered as-is by the live console.

auditId.description: Audit this event belongs to; matches the auditId in the stream path.

payload.description: Event-specific data; shape is determined by `type`.

agentThoughtEvent.description: Agent reasoning step, streamed live to the console (e.g. 'Analyzing auth.ts for injection sinks').

content.description: Free-form reasoning text shown in the live console.

step.description: Optional label of the current audit phase (clone, analyze, remediate...).

toolExecutionEvent.description: Tool/step execution trace (git clone, file read, LLM call). Also models LLM provider degradation as a failed/degraded outcome instead of an HTTP error (NFR-A3).

tool.description: Tool or step identifier, e.g. git-clone, read-file, llm-analyze.

input.description: Sanitized tool inputs; must not embed secrets or full file dumps.

status.description: Execution outcome. `degraded` marks LLM throttling/fallback to Ollama (NFR-A3).

output.description: Short human-readable result summary for the console.

error.description: Failure detail when status is failed or degraded.

vulnerabilityFoundEvent.description: One actionable finding with Before/After snippets (principle §5.5 — findings without fixes are incomplete output). Mirrors the Finding schema in specs/openapi.yaml.

auditCompletedEvent.description: Terminal event of every audit stream. `status: failed` covers engine crashes so no stream is ever left open; error detail travels in the payload.

healthScore.description: Overall health score 0-100; present when the audit completed.

summary.description: Final counters (findings per severity, rules evaluated, duration).

error.description: Failure detail when status is failed.
